name: Debora Wayne
reason: Her work is mainly treatment of medical conditions: she runs the International Chronic Pain Institute, her HighSpeed Healing method is presented as treating chronic pain, depression, anxiety, insomnia and similar conditions, her book is Why Do I Still Hurt?, and her only Shift course is 'Energy Healing for Chronic Health Issues', so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule (her website, internationalcpi.com, refused both curl and WebFetch with 403).
